The '''Rigovia system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa]], [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and [[Relatta system/Legends|Relatta systems]]<ref name="Relatta">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places the Rigovia [[Star system/Legends|system]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] between the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]], and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in turn places the [[Relatta system/Legends|Relatta system]] on that same segment of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], therefore the Relatta and Rigovia systems must have been connected by it.</ref> and served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Regions" />

The Rigovia [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Rigovian Technical University]].<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the former was the site of a Class II military [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The output of the facility was limited to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rigovia system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
